title: Beach Slides for Men – Non-Slip Garden Shoes
descriptionHtml:
Comfortable shoes for the patio, the beach and the garden

Ordinary shoes get hot and sweaty in summer, and you don't want to drag soil and water into the house every time you step outside. At the same time you don't want to slip on a wet deck or a wet lawn.

Easy to step into, comfortable all day

These slides in soft EVA material are light, non-slip and dry quickly. The thick sole cushions every step and grips well on both a wet patio and grass. Perfect to step into when you need to pop out to the garden or down to the water.

Features

  • Soft and light EVA material that dries quickly
  • Thick sole that cushions and gives support
  • Non-slip pattern for a secure grip
  • Easy to rinse clean
  • Perfect for beach, pool, patio and garden

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
